tldr: 台股最近交易日重挫約1,768點、寫史上第七大收盤跌點，外資大舉提款權王台積電。
輝達示警AI需求強勁、台積電全力增援供應，法人估台積電2026毛利率可守六成。
金管會推動資產管理中心與ETF國際化，海外股票ETF受益人連九周創新高。

items.title_zh: 台股重挫 寫史上第七大跌點（最近交易日）
items.title_en: Taiwan shares suffer one of their worst sessions on record (2026-11-20)
items.summary_zh: 受費城半導體指數單日重挫逾一成拖累，外資大舉調節權值股，加權指數最近交易日急殺約1,768點，為史上第七大收盤跌點；全週累計下跌約7,641點。市場對AI晶片股評價快速修正，權值股成為提款重災區，拖累指數失守多道技術關卡。
items.summary_en: On the latest trading session the TAIEX plunged roughly 1,768 points, its seventh-largest point drop ever, as a slide of more than 10% in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index triggered heavy foreign selling of heavyweight TSMC. The island's benchmark lost about 7,641 points over the week, reflecting a rapid global de-rating of AI-related chip names.

items.title_zh: 外資賣超收斂 台積電仍遭提款（最近交易日）
items.title_en: Foreign outflows narrow but TSMC still hit hard (2026-11-20)
items.summary_zh: 最近交易日外資在集中市場賣超縮小至約94億元，但權值王台積電仍被賣超約1.18萬張，外資已連七個交易日調節台積電。所幸投信買盤進場部分承接，顯示外資避險性賣壓與本土低接買盤相互拉鋸，後市仍須觀察外資動向是否止穩。
items.summary_en: Net foreign selling on the main board eased to about NT$9.4 billion in the latest session, yet overseas funds still offloaded roughly 11,800 lots of TSMC, extending their selling streak in the chipmaker to seven straight sessions. Domestic investment trusts partly absorbed the pressure, highlighting a tug-of-war between foreign risk-off flows and local bargain hunting.

items.title_zh: 台積電高層親訪輝達 供應鏈全力增援
items.title_en: TSMC leadership visits Nvidia as supply chain ramps
items.summary_zh: 輝達在最新法說會透露，台積電領導層本週造訪並全力支援，財務長Kress指出記憶體與先進封裝供給已獲確保；輝達並將未來營收成長預估上修至約75%，歸因於供應鏈增援。顯示AI晶片需求延續，台灣晶圓代工與先進封裝生態系可望續受惠，供應穩定性成市場焦點。
items.summary_en: Nvidia said on its latest earnings call that TSMC's top management visited this week and is going all-out to support demand, while CFO Colette Kress noted memory and advanced-packaging supply has been secured. Nvidia lifted its forward revenue-growth outlook toward about 75%, citing stronger supply-chain backing — a signal of durable AI chip demand flowing to Taiwan's foundry and packaging ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 法人估台積電2026毛利率可守六成
items.title_en: Analysts see TSMC 2026 gross margin holding near 60%
items.summary_zh: 法人預估，在先進製程報價與AI需求帶動產能高度利用下，台積電2026全年毛利率可望維持約六成。此看法強化先進製程與先進封裝產能滿載的預期，意味獲利動能有望延續至2027年，與近期晶片股價急挫形成對比，凸顯基本面與股價短線脫鉤。
items.summary_en: Brokerages project TSMC can sustain a full-year 2026 gross margin of around 60%, underpinned by advanced-node pricing and robust AI-driven utilization. The view reinforces expectations that leading-edge and advanced-packaging capacity remain effectively sold out, supporting earnings momentum into 2027 despite the sharp pullback in chip-sector share prices.

items.title_zh: 金管會推資產管理中心 ETF邁向國際化
items.title_en: FSC pushes Taiwan asset-management hub and ETF globalization
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆重申，將打造具台灣特色的資產管理中心，並推動本土ETF邁向國際化，相關談話於投資大趨勢論壇場合提出。政策目標在深化資本市場廣度、引導家庭儲蓄進入受管理商品，亦是將台灣定位為亞洲財富與創新交會點整體布局的一環。
items.summary_en: FSC Chairman Peng Chin-lung reiterated the regulator's goal of building an asset-management center with Taiwanese characteristics and internationalizing local ETFs, in remarks around the investment mega-trend forum. The policy aims to deepen capital-market breadth and channel household savings into managed products, part of a broader drive to position Taiwan as an Asian wealth and innovation hub.

items.title_zh: 高雄資產管理專區進駐62家機構
items.summary_zh: 報導指出，高雄資產管理專區已有62家金融機構進駐、高資產客戶逾1萬人；首屆高雄國際金融博覽會聚焦家族辦公室、ETF投資與數位金融。此聚落顯示政策推動台灣財富管理版圖向台北以外擴散，強化南部金融能量，吸引金控業者加碼布局家族辦公室服務。
items.summary_en: Reports say Kaohsiung's asset-management special zone has attracted 62 financial institutions serving more than 10,000 high-net-worth clients, as the inaugural Kaohsiung international financial expo showcased family offices, ETF investing and digital finance. The cluster signals policymakers' effort to broaden Taiwan's wealth-management footprint beyond Taipei and build southern financial capacity.

items.title_zh: 海外股票ETF受益人連九周創高
items.title_en: Overseas-equity ETF holders hit record for a ninth straight week
items.summary_zh: 集保中心資料顯示，海外股票ETF受益人連續九周寫新高，其中以美國股票ETF最受青睞。此趨勢反映台灣投資人對全球分散配置的需求升溫，即便本土晶片股重挫，散戶資金仍持續流向海外指數型商品，海外ETF逐漸成為資產配置的新寵，顯示配置思維國際化。
items.summary_en: TDCC data show the number of beneficiaries in overseas-equity ETFs has set fresh highs for nine consecutive weeks, with U.S. stock ETFs the most popular. The trend underscores Taiwanese investors' growing appetite for global diversification; even as domestic chip names tumble, retail flows keep heading toward offshore index products.

items.title_zh: 債券與高股息ETF領軍11月除息
items.title_en: Bond and high-yield ETFs headline early-November distributions
items.summary_zh: 市場報導指出，11月首周有9檔股債ETF除息，多數為債券ETF，最後買進日吸引存息買盤進場。另元大高股息0056等商品強調兼顧績效與配息，顯示存股族由單純追求殖利率，轉向重視殖利率與資本利得並重的配置思維，高股息商品也更看重長期總報酬表現。
items.summary_en: Market coverage flags nine stock and bond ETFs going ex-dividend in the first week of November, most of them bond ETFs, with the final entitlement dates drawing income-seeking buyers. Separately, high-dividend products such as Yuanta 0056 are emphasizing total-return performance, reflecting a shift among income investors toward funds that balance yield with capital growth.
